 KUALA LUMPUR: Tesla has introduced its Certified Pre-Owned programme in Malaysia.
 Tesla Malaysia says every Certified Pre-Owned Tesla vehicle is fully inspected and refurbished by Tesla-qualified technicians and parts to ensure the vehicle is road-ready.
 "Each Certified Pre-Owned Tesla vehicle has passed the 102-point inspection of its mechanical conditions, safety system and functionalities, interior and exterior cosmetic conditions," says the company.
 Basic Autopilot or Enhanced Autopilot function is also included for the new Tesla owners to experience self-driving capability, depending on the selected inventory and its availability.
 In addition, all Certified Pre-Owned Tesla vehicles are covered by the coverage remaining on the vehicle’s original new vehicle limited warranty and an additional one-year or 20,000km, whichever comes first.
 Browse tesla.com/en_MY for the latest inventory.
 Through regular Over-The-Air (OTA) updates, Tesla vehicles receive new features and refinements without a service centre visit.
 A Certified Pre-Owned Tesla remains part of this ecosystem, subject to model, hardware, and eligibility.
 The latest OTA update experience includes Grok, a personal AI assistant in all Tesla vehicles.
 Drivers can navigate, adjust climate, play music, set reminders, find places, and control vehicle features through a more natural, hassle-free interaction.
 Festive updates will also be available for different seasons, in which owners can dress up their vehicle on the screen, synchronise light show, customise lock sound or play with themed photo booth like the Halloween updates in October.
 Customers who want to upgrade, change configuration, or move into another Tesla can also enquire directly about selling or trading in their current vehicle.
 Tesla Malaysia will host the first Open House event at Tesla Experience Centre Cyberjaya on November 21 – 22, 2026, from 10am to 7pm.
 Visitors can experience the the latest Model 3, Model Y and Model Y L through test drive, while exploring Certified Pre-Owned Tesla vehicles.
 Selected vehicles start at RM135,000.
